text: 1，整体走势：市场全天探底回升，三大指数集体调整，科创50跌超5%。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市超3600股飘绿，今日成交2.36万亿。截止收盘沪指跌0.62%，深成指跌2.73%，创业板指跌3.97%。 2，行业板块：白酒、汽车整车、教育、油气等板块涨幅居前，半导体、CPO、存储芯片、玻璃基板等板块跌幅居前。 3，热门概念：消费股逆势走强，一鸣食品3连板，金徽酒、舍得酒业等涨停。银行板块震荡拉升，工商银行、建设银行均创历史新高。下跌方面，半导体芯片股走低，长电科技、通富微电等跌停，华虹宏力、寒武纪等跌超10%；算力硬件股下挫，剑桥科技、东山精密等跌停，新易
text_en: 1. Overall trend: Markets dipped then recovered, with all major indices declining; the STAR 50 fell over 5%. More stocks fell than rose, with over 3,600 stocks in the red across the three boards; turnover was 2.36 trillion yuan. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.62%, the Shenzhen Component fell 2.73%, and the ChiNext fell 3.97%. 2. Sectors: Baijiu, auto OEMs, education, and oil & gas led gains; semiconductors, CPO, memory chips, and glass substrates led losses. 3. Hot concepts: Consumer stocks bucked the trend, with Yiming Food hitting three consecutive limit-ups, and Jinhui Liquor and Shede Spirits hitting limit-up. Banks rose, with ICBC and CCB hitting record highs.
